explication: OpenCV is a computer-vision library with application and accelerator-backend code represented in this tree. One visible user workflow is interactive calibration: acquire camera or video frames, pass them to frame processors, display results, and return user actions. The tree also shows image-filtering internals and DNN integrations for OpenVINO and Vulkan. The README is introductory rather than a capability catalogue, and most runtime modules are not listed here, so this map is limited to the evidenced components rather than attempting a full library inventory.
